name: Herby Bulgur Salad with Feta
description: Lots of parsley and mint, nutty bulgur wheat, crunchy cucumber and salty feta. Keeps well for packed lunches.
recipeIngredient: 1 large bunch flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
Small bunch of mint, leaves chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the bulgur in boiling salted water for 10 minutes, or according to the packet. Drain well, spread out on a tray and leave to cool.
Toss the bulgur with the cucumber, tomatoes, herbs and spring onions.
Whisk the lemon juice and oil with plenty of seasoning, pour over and mix. Crumble over the feta to serve.
